reviewType: Independent runtime/contract design review; not implementation QA or lifecycle readiness
summary: The selected declarative artifact2 branch through ordinary admission/recorded child is sound and preserves the intended legacy separation. The frozen document is not yet a sufficiently closed implementation contract: historical guard evidence is not retained by the current code, the independent validator lacks a trusted facts input, exact wire/profile/byte contracts and account consumption ABI are unfinished, and one operation-equivalence statement contradicts the actual guided primitive. These are bounded design/ownership corrections within OBS-006, not demands to implement OBS-007 or the later benchmark/pilot.
acceptedDecisions: Choose closed typed artifact2 rather than new executable JavaScript grammar or a second guided run. Keep artifact1 AST/reference-policy2/locator fallback and ordinary RUN auto-accept behavior unchanged.

Keep database revision UUID distinct from cryptographic revisionDigest. Original Run/admission identities are publication provenance; each explicit later run obtains its own execution/attempt/current authorization.
Keep captured values entirely execution-local and fresh; the existing ordinary run admission, cancellation, confined child, recording/timeline and evidence path remain authoritative.
Observed profile matching must be exact and separately catalogued, without feeding observed-2 into legacy semver comparisons or globally flipping legacy CompilePins.

Publication is browser-free, gateway-free and does not claim replay verification or create an ordinary successful run. Production account connection remains the only deliberately unavailable later port.

blockers.title: Missing retained evidence and independent guard-validation basis
blockers.finding: Design section3 assumes retained observations for each successful preparation. Current observe() overwrites progress.observation; the ordinary observation command stores a session response, not that observation; GuidedPreparationStore persists proof/hash/expiry but no node facts. Learned-plan2 stores locator/operation/read/graph identities, not the role/element/control facts used for guards. The proposed /v2/validate-observed request includes source/reference names, artifact and policy only. Node cannot independently derive those facts from that request and would only validate/hash lowerer-produced guards.
requiredResolution: Define append-only per-preparation/admission observation evidence capture for newly publication-base-enabled sessions, while the exact matching observation is still current. Under the existing session/source lock verify full observationHash, proposal target document/generation/node, proof requestDigest/evidenceHash, source/context/fence and later immutable admission association. Store the complete sanitized observation once by hash, or an equally independently verifiable immutable selected-node snapshot plus its full-hash provenance. Never reconstruct earlier facts from the final page or current policy; missing historical facts refuse adoption.

Add a separate closed validationBasis input to the pure Node endpoint, populated from original immutable source/materialization/preparation/observation records by the snapshot reader, not from ObservedArtifactLowerer output. Bind basisHash into snapshotHash, persisted validation identity/receipt and final CAS. Node resolves each proposal target into that independent observation, checks hashes/identities and derives guards and input-recipe mappings itself before comparing artifact/IR/policy/equivalenceHash.

Retained audit evidence may include historical node/document/generation IDs for pure verification. Strip them from executable artifact guard/IR authority and all child IPC. Do not mutate the existing learned-plan2 schema merely to smuggle current-node authority into replay.

Only freeze facts actually recorded. Observation controlType=other does not prove a precise original native checkbox/radio/number subtype; either constrain guards to recorded facts plus current operation-compatible checks, or explicitly version/capture any stronger needed attestation. Do not infer missing type/policy-file facts.
regressions: Execute at least two different documents/generations, then prove the publisher reads each action original immutable facts after latest progress is overwritten.

Mutate guard role/type/classification/locator and recompute every artifact-local hash: Node must reject against unchanged independent basis. Mutating the basis or its joins must fail snapshot/final-CAS binding.
Old session with no base/evidence refuses; no synthetic backfill or another browser execution.

blockers.title: Closed artifact/policy/IR/profile/job/IPC and composite byte bounds remain undefined
blockers.finding: The artifact lists top-level names but inputRecipes, guards, replayPolicy, ObservedReplayProfile and operations remain unspecified types. The job observed-only component, admission observed subdocument, protocol2 launch/execute/ready/result branches and validation request/verdict lack exact fields and discriminators. Only max-artifact-bytes=1MiB and max-envelope-bytes=2MiB are named. That is insufficient to implement mutually strict Java/Node/IPC boundaries or to ensure the artifact + source + independent evidence + resolved inputs fit their actual readers.
requiredResolution: Freeze exact closed definitions and discriminator placement before parallel implementation: artifact version2/kind observed, policy version3, profile version/catalog ID, /v2 job observed metadata, and launch/execute protocolVersion2 with mode observed. Specify no null/absent fallback into legacy parsing; /v1 refuses the observed family and /v2 refuses mixed or legacy shapes.

Define operation IR as the exact ordered source coordinate/origin/locator/typed operation plus deterministic guard association; specify input recipe variants and producer/consumer graph projection. Give max steps/actions/statements/input recipes/guards/bindings/edges/string sizes and require exact cardinality/order and graph coverage. No historical availability/proposal/ledger/context permissions in child IR.

Define request, response and IPC UTF-8 byte caps, JSON depth, integer/Unicode rules, collection cardinalities and serialized resolved-input/handle budgets; apply bounded body reads before JSON parse and parent/child frame checks before traversal. Preserve legacy body/64KiB artifact rules. Distinguish pure-validator request cap from artifact and run-job cap because it contains independent source/evidence data.

Account for the full composed request/job, not only artifact bytes: publication validation and acceptance must reject an over-cap serialization explicitly, without truncation, uncapped buffering or marking a structurally valid artifact executable under incompatible body limits. Preserve existing ordinary per-step/total runtime limits.

Specify child ready/result family/profile echo and parent verification, including finite measured timing numbers separately from the canonical integer-only artifact domain. Existing protocol1 child messages do not carry this family proof.
regressions: Cross-family/mixed protocol and profile mutations fail before capacity/browser.
Every body/frame limit at limit-1/limit/limit+1 using escaped Unicode and worst-case bounded arrays.
Whole-artifact, source, originalText, code, functions, undeclared bindings and prefilled capture values are rejected by both parent and child.
Recorded child with mismatched observed profile/ready echo cannot execute.

blockers.title: Account-handle and trusted policy installation ABI is not yet implementable
blockers.finding: Section7 names AccountAccess.authorizeReplay and worker consumption but leaves wire shape, issuer/consumer, resolution location, one-use scope, failure timing and production startup wiring open. Current AccountAccess is nested in GuidedProductionSessionAccess and has only resolve/checkCurrent; ordinary child entry supplies only browser factory. An opaque string alone cannot establish current account authorization or define how the same recorded browser receives setup.
requiredResolution: Freeze a neutral replay-account SPI and closed ephemeral grant/handle DTO binding grantId, executionId, attemptId, revisionDigest, current scopeHash/principal/CSI/environment/application/accountRef, allowed origins, required initialContext/entry-policy identity, issuedAt/expiresAt and opaque handle/provider ID. Bound the handle; classify it as sensitive capability data, never publish/log/hash its bytes into immutable revision evidence.

Specify authorize at current acceptance/dispatch, recheck at admission/consume, and consume at most once for the addressed admitted attempt. The consumer is a trusted configured worker-side provider, not a job-selected URL, module, source, cookie import or account guess. Define exact injected prepare/apply/dispose methods and their same-recorded-page capability. A default provider refuses before browser work; OBS-007 supplies actual account connection implementation.

Separate current trusted read/egress policy installation from artifact claims: load a versioned mounted catalog selected by authorized app/account/policy identities and validate required recipe/guard against that catalog. Freeze a bounded typed policy snapshot into protocol2, or declare a fixed allowlisted child configuration path; never permit arbitrary artifact rules/paths/modules or broad service credentials in the child.

Name the production startup wiring path and controlled-account test seam. Define how blank-start remains genuinely blank, and how observedDocument entry requires an explicit replayable entry policy rather than inventing a URL from origin. Failure/lost consume acknowledgement cannot repeat account setup or application effects.
regressions: Missing/unconfigured/expired/wrong-execution/wrong-account/wrong-origin handle refuses before browser application work.
Only account seam is controlled while actual production dispatcher/child/recording execute.
Stop between grant and apply, duplicated handle consumption, and replayable-entry mismatch never import another context or repeat setup.
Revoke mounted read policy while preserving artifact bytes; dependent read refuses without model fallback.

blockers.title: Operation semantics table contradicts the exercised fill/select primitive
blockers.finding: Section7 groups fill/selectOption with native input and says not DOM dispatch. Actual guided collector intentionally implements fill and selectOption with a fixed isolated DOM value assignment plus input/change events, while click/check/uncheck/hover/press use dispatchNativeInput. Replacing the former with generic Playwright/native entry changes focus/event/default behavior and is not automatically equivalent to the exercised path.
requiredResolution: Split the operation table: pointer/key operations reuse nativeInput plus retained-target checks and uncertainty classification; fill/selectOption reuse their existing fixed trusted isolated primitive and exact type/value/origin checks. This does not authorize arbitrary artifact DOM evaluation or event construction.

If different fill/select semantics are desired, treat that as an explicit algorithm/profile amendment with independent equivalence evidence, not an implementation detail or a legacy adapter fallback. Retain no-effect refusal versus post-focus/scroll/input UNKNOWN_OUTCOME distinctions and acknowledge residual native focus/coordinate races.
regressions: Reactive form fixtures verify exact input/change event behavior and final server receipts for guided and replay fill/select.
Native Tab/Arrow/Enter/hover/trusted click and below-fold reveal remain actual browser tests, with focus theft/overlay/replacement/cancel fault cases.

blockers.title: Hash field definitions and opaque configuration recipe joins need reconciliation
blockers.finding: The existing contract defines admissionProvenanceHash as an ordered ledger tuple array, whereas the design reuses that name for a broader publication evidence object. Existing readiness sourceHash is H(ordered source string array), while source/configuration/authoring identity wording does not fix that exact representation. Config source references are opaque cfg-UUID IDs; reference names alone are not an independent mapping from those IDs. Java canonical permits printable ASCII object keys and Node guided canonical accepts a narrower key grammar.
requiredResolution: Keep existing operation/learned-plan/admission-provenance algorithms unchanged, or explicitly give the broader publication evidence hash a new name/version (for example publicationEvidenceHash) and bind both in revisionDigest. Do not silently reinterpret an established hash label.

Freeze sourceHash as the existing ordered-source hash for common readiness compatibility; bind stable source UUID/order and authoring identity separately. Freeze configurationHash to the explicit CompileInputs configuration representation and bind configurationRevision/reference metadata separately; do not send saved variable values to the pure validator.

Supply immutable value-free configuration mappings {referenceId,referenceName,stepId,kind,intendedSlot} and inputId/provenance mappings in validationBasis. Node must derive recipes from those mappings, not trust renamed lowerer recipes. Backend independently checks the original authoredInputsHash against its immutable private table; do not claim Node recomputes a private-value table hash without those bytes.

Freeze the common canonical domain for the new artifact/basis/profile: arrays for opaque-ID keyed collections, fixed closed field names, well-formed Unicode without normalization, safe integer range, negative-zero/float/duplicate-key/BOM handling. Prove ArtifactCanonicalizer roundtrip and Node bytes agree for persisted JSONB snapshots, rather than changing legacy canonical semantics globally.
regressions: Java/Node fixed vectors with accented text, astral characters, combining sequences, quotes/backslashes/control escaping, maximum safe integer, invalid surrogate/negative-zero/duplicate-key refusals and JSONB serialization roundtrip.
Swap opaque configuration reference/name/step/slot while recomputing artifact hashes: independent immutable mapping check refuses.
Old golden admissionProvenanceHash remains unchanged; broad publication evidence changes its separately named/versioned digest.

recommendedIndependentValidationBasis.requestEnvelope: Closed {schemaVersion, snapshotHash, requiredProfile, artifact, validationBasis}; exact source/reference metadata belongs inside the independently assembled basis rather than unbound parallel parameters.
basisContents: Immutable ordered sourceSteps {stepId,text} and original source/configuration/authoring identities.
Original source-input IDs and value-free exact sourceSpan/configuration provenance; declared configuration-reference ID-to-name/step/kind/slot mapping.
Original run authorization identity/hash, accepted translation revision/hash and complete exercised learned-plan identity.
Ordered action joins with immutable proposal/ledger/preparation identities and hashes, and retained sanitized observations deduplicated by observationHash.
Trusted frozen replay scope/policy requirements from server snapshots, not lowerer output.
nodeAlgorithm: Validate closed schemas and canonical bounds for basis and artifact, recompute basisHash/snapshot linkage and each supplied observation/proposal/operation hash.

Join successful admission/preparation to its original target in the corresponding immutable observation using audit node/document/generation identifiers. Validate exact locator correspondence metadata and read recipe/classification/type relationships. These are historical source facts; live DOM proof remains the original authenticated preparation.

Derive the expected stable guard and input/operation/graph projection independently, dropping historical node/document/context/availability authority. Compare exact cardinality/order/fields to artifact guards, steps, recipes and policy3, then compute equivalence hash.

Return a hash-bound verdict including basisHash, artifactHash, learnedPlanHash, referencePolicyHash, operationEquivalenceHash and actual immutable profile. The publisher rechecks original DB snapshot/basis and verdict identity at final CAS.
recommendedIndependentValidationBasis.trustLimit: Node validates the deterministic transformation against independently fetched trusted server evidence. It does not re-run the browser or independently establish arbitrary-English meaning, original private saved-input bytes, policy-file digests never recorded, or protection against a malicious authority replacing both original DB evidence and all attestations.

wireAndRuntimeMandatoryConditions: Policy3 binds learnedPlanHash, original Run/admission/publication-evidence identity, exact input recipes, earlier producer definitions and concrete consumer slots/origins. It is required for artifact2; omission cannot fall back to source-token policy2. Keep v1 default/optional policy behavior untouched.

Keep executable graph separate from original producerAvailability/contextId/fence/admission rights and sampled values. Child value map starts empty for each execution/attempt, accepts only successful local reads once, and is cleared on every termination path.

Observed adapter resolves the frozen locator uniquely using the same private collector/masking/native primitives; no legacy visible-only or textbox-role alternatives, no new locator, no sample literal, no model or implicit relearning.

Bind the exact observed profile to artifact, validation result, accepted execution record, job, backend admission runtime subdocument, parent launch and child ready/result. Add an observed catalog alongside existing legacy fields, not new meaning for executor2.1.0 or global ARTIFACT_VERSION. Exact missing/stale profile refusal precedes browser work.

Configure observed-only body limits and typed branch before route parse/coordinator validation. Keep existing /v1 JSON/body/key limits and AST semantics. Declare whether DELETE /v1/runs/{id} deliberately controls both admitted families or add a corresponding v2 cancel route and backend transport selection; do not leave cancel pointing at an unregistered family.

Select data-free diagnostics before spawn/browser start, including parent relay/raw output, child errors, page URL/title/locator/hosts, result/manifest and account errors. Preserve identity/status/timing/step indexes and authorized video/seek metadata. Captured values never cross IPC; authorized per-run inputs still may cross their explicit private typed channel.

Keep sandbox enabled, one page/context, scratch isolation, environment/execArgv allowlists and existing total/per-step deadline/kill behavior. Account wiring may not import vault/identity/LLM clients or a job-selected module/URL into the child.

Keep deployment disabled until the exact profile is installed fleet-wide and conformance/real replay gates pass. Drain before removing a supported profile; rollback must refuse observed jobs/revisions without reinterpretation while preserving legacy runs and immutable evidence.

ownershipReview.status: 121 literal paths verified; major planned domains are covered, but unresolved ABI/basis definitions prevent a complete ownership freeze.
alreadyCovered: Normal RunJob/HTTP dispatcher/admission/coordinator, profile build scripts, validator/executor/adapter, protocol/launcher/childRuntime/browser, diagnostics/evidence classes and substantial dual-family tests are reserved.
GuidedSessionService and GuidedSessionConfiguration are reserved, allowing a publication-evidence capture hook if its repository/interface is explicitly assigned.

GuidedProductionSessionAccess is reserved, but its nested AccountAccess currently lacks replay authorization; ordinary replay should not acquire a dependency on translation orchestration merely to obtain an account port.

Suggested missing literal path for the observed metadata/current-scope/account/profile discriminated job. It may instead be explicitly defined and drift-tested in the already-owned OpenAPI, but not left as prose.
Suggested missing literal path for exact protocol2 frame schemas/fixtures; alternatively freeze these closed definitions in owned protocol.ts with cross-language fixtures.

Suggested explicit owner for append-only original prepared-observation capture/read. Could be a named capability of existing reserved GuidedPublicationRepository instead, but capture-before-loss and persistence tests must be allocated.

Suggested neutral SPI/records outside translation orchestration for authorizeReplay. Can be nested in an already-owned neutral pure contract file if architect explicitly chooses that; actual OBS-007 provider remains deferred.

Not in121; this is the actual process entry binding browser factory to childRuntime. Reserve it if account/policy provider wiring or controlled account injection changes the entry. Otherwise specify the concrete default provider factory constructed wholly inside already-owned childRuntime/observedAccount and test that exact production path.

Existing raw-wire legacy body conformance seam is not in121. Run unchanged to prove legacy serialization; add ownership only if new v2 assertions are placed there rather than in existing reserved observed tests.

Not in121; result runtime map is currently open. Can remain untouched if observed admission identity is independently immutable and existing output framing remains compatible. If adding a family-specific terminal payload/identity or tighter byte behavior, explicitly reserve this plus reporting tests/bounds.

doNotExpandByDefault: No need to edit v1 AST/language, StepReferencePolicyDeriver or legacy referencePolicy parser for the chosen declarative branch.

Do not widen eslint/dependency allowlists. Existing test/run/confinement.test.ts and test/isolation.test.ts are the real regression gates; proposed test/run/playwright-confinement.test.ts is a new file, not an existing gate to replace.
Do not assume listed new classes/schemas already exist; observedAccount.ts and build-studio-observed-schemas.cjs are proposals.

requiredProofBeforeImplementationQa: One actual guided submit and zero browser/gateway actions during finalization, including conflicts/retries; two explicit normal admitted recorded child replays with identical artifact/plan/policy hashes and independent fresh-value receipts. Both gateway HTTP counters stay zero after authoring.
Independent guard mutation with all artifact-local hashes recomputed; original evidence/basis stays fixed. Missing per-action historical snapshots must refuse publication.

Current scope/account/policy/initial-state mutations, no hidden-source/state repair, native/isolated fill-select equivalence, runtime value lifetime/isolation and data-free parent/child canaries with playable recording/seek evidence.
Exact family/profile/hash/byte/canonical boundary refusals before capacity/browser plus legacy AST/policy/locator/profile/RUN-auto-accept/manual-confirm/cancel/evidence regression coverage.
